criteria.rationale: Eleven scoped coordination requirements, 24 planned cases and all native owners traced; original acceptance unchanged.
Typed orchestration and separate operator input are defined; no runtime proof, authenticated boundary or complete original contracts.
One C0 ledger, bounded JSON selectors and finite native registry reuse existing components without a broker, framework or new model.
No run result exists; native model binding/assistance, forecasts, reports, decisions and effects remain distinct.
Finite byte/count/time/native-call bounds and completion reservations coded; hard isolation, full cost and measured scalability remain open.
Exact intents, original native keys, explicit uncertainty, attempt history/fences and finite recovery paths exist in source; none executed.
Existing authority/tool specifications and repository patterns reused; no new product ranking/performance claim or dependency introduced.
Latest user instruction defers every test/runtime/example/solver/model/gate run; source/artifact checks only.

whole_system_review.ownership: C0 orchestration; C1 raw evidence; C3 model/admission; C5 trial dynamics; C6 sealed assessment; C7 actual policy.
whole_system_review.authority: No new C4/C5/C6-C7 bypass; explicit operator data path and disabled-by-default profile remain trusted-local, not authentication.
whole_system_review.recovery: No cross-owner transaction; caller queries native status and exact original request when completion is unknown; finite reserved receipts and attempt fences.
whole_system_review.feedback: Neither model candidate, generated report, imported assistance nor successful dispatch is independent truth or measured effect.
whole_system_review.capacity: Finite acyclic plans and indexed workflow selections; no hard process limit/instant latency/HA or arbitrary scale claim.
